name: Barbell Flat Bench Press
science: High mechanical tension across sternal pectoralis; optimal for progressive overload.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press (30°)
science: 30° bench angle maximizes clavicular (upper) pec activation while limiting anterior delt takeover.

name: Weighted / Bodyweight Pull-Ups
science: Full overhead scapular depression and adduction builds vertical lat width and upper-back thickness.

name: Barbell Back Squat
science: High systemic loading; deep knee flexion maximizes quadriceps and adductor magnus hypertrophy.

name: Trap Bar / Conventional Deadlift
science: Peak posterior-chain force output across hamstrings, glutes, and spinal erectors.

name: Weighted RKC Plank Hold
science: Maximal glute and abdominal co-contraction doubles rectus abdominis EMG vs standard planks.

name: World's Greatest Stretch Flow
science: Simultaneously mobilizes hip flexors, hamstrings, thoracic rotation, and ankle dorsiflexion.
